subject: Quarterly handback: goals, OKRs, and manager notes sync
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Janelle Torres <janelle@northshore.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarterly handback: goals, OKRs, and manager notes sync

Hi team —

We're entering the mid-Q check window and I'd like to coordinate manager notes and any org-change talking points before we send consolidated feedback to ICs and People. Goals:
- Collect manager-written summaries for direct reports (strengths, development areas, proposed calibration bucket)
- Agree on any role/level changes to propose to People by EOW
- Ensure language is consistent for externally facing handbacks (customers/partners)

Action items: please drop your completed manager notes into the Q2 manager template (attached) by Thursday EOD (4/22). Laura — can HR run a quick legal/phrasing scan for any sensitive wording around performance-related transitions, and flag anything that needs escalation?

I'll host a 30-min calibration sync on Friday 4/23 @ 10:30 PT to align. Calendar invite to follow. If you think we need a separate skip-level conversation for anyone, flag it in the doc and we'll triage.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Eng Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q2_manager_notes_template.xlsx (spreadsheet, manager notes template)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly handback: goals, OKRs, and manager notes sync

Mina —

Thanks for the heads-up. HR can run the language pass; I'll prioritize the cases you flagged in private Slack earlier (compensation-impacting role changes and any PIPs). A couple of quick notes:
- For role/level change proposals, please include the proposed new title, effective date, and the business rationale field in the template — it speeds review.
- Avoid using absolute language like "not meeting expectations" without context; instead we prefer "areas where performance has not met role expectations" and examples.

I'll review submitted templates by Friday morning and return a redline if needed. Also, if any manager is proposing to remove or reduce responsibilities, include a transfer plan (owner and timeline).

Laura Bennett
Sr. People Partner
Redwood Inference

Attachment: HR-guidance-performance-language.pdf (stub)

Mina / Laura —

Uploaded my team's notes to the template this morning. High-level flags:
- Priya N. — strong execution on inference throughput, suggest stretch goal for system design mentorship; no level change.
- Rishi M. — delivery cadence slipped for two sprints; recommend performance plan with measurable milestones and weekly check-ins for 60 days.
- Janelle (contractor) — contract renewal pending; I've added a short blurb for Commercial about retention value.

Laura: I added the proposed wording for Rishi in the "development plan" section. Happy to talk through phrasing — I can reword if HR prefers something softer.

I'll be at the calibration sync on Friday.

—Aditya

Thanks both — great progress. Meeting notes and final consolidated doc are attached (PDF summary + link below).

Summary / next steps:

- Priya: no change; assign mentorship objective in next sprint's plan.
- Janelle (contractor): Commercial will lead renewal conversation; I've cc'd them on the updated note.
- I'll send the external-facing handback language to Janelle for partner context after we finalize internal wording.

Final attachments: 2027-04-23_minute-summary.pdf; Q2_manager_notes_template.xlsx (finalized with redlines).

Google doc (consolidated): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c_minahandoff
